change: CRITICAL FIX: found the real cause of the form not clearing after Save. saveSupervisorEntry() cleared job rows for all 6 departments unconditionally (document.getElementById('rows-'+d).innerHTML='') even for departments the truck didn't use, whose row elements don't exist in the DOM at all. That threw a TypeError which silently aborted the rest of the function -- INCLUDING every field-clearing step below it -- right after the 'Inspection saved' toast had already fired. So the save succeeded, the toast showed, but the whole form (Origin, Trailer No, Driver Name, Fuel, ETD, etc.) stayed full of the just-submitted truck's data. Now guarded with a null check per department, and every step in the save flow (detectRevisits, refreshes, save) is individually try/caught so one failing step can no longer block the rest.
